name: Ana Maria Paranhos de Amorim
about-1: I hold a Ph.D. in Computer Science and am a senior IT professional with extensive experience developing and maintaining enterprise systems. Throughout my career, I have worked in large-scale data processing environments, focusing on systems analysis, bug fixes and enhancements, technical documentation, and understanding business rules.
about-2: I built most of my experience working with legacy technologies, including COBOL and Natural (Software AG). This gave me a strong foundation in programming logic, building reliable systems, organizing technical work, and understanding critical business processes.
about-3: More recently, I expanded into web development, API-based system integration, and process automation. I developed and deployed a web application using React, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, and Vite, with API integrations for Manychat, WhatsApp, and Google Sheets. My work included data validation and processing, contact creation and updates, workflow automation, testing, and production deployment using Git, GitHub, and Vercel.
about-4: This recent work builds on my experience in requirements analysis, application support, testing, technical documentation, data, and systems modernization. It allows me to apply my enterprise systems background to modern technologies and integration approaches.
project1-desc: Personal website created to showcase my projects and professional information.
project3-desc: Full stack project - frontend, backend and database.
project3-tech: Technologies: BD: MongoDB; Backend: Node.js + MongoDB; Frontend: React
project4-desc: I developed the registration flow for the UTI na Real medical education community. It validates the form fields, saves registration data to Google Sheets, then connects to WhatsApp via ManyChat. The flow also includes a confirmation page.
project5-desc: I developed a web application for independent medical practices, with patient search, visit history, consultation notes, and tools for issuing prescriptions and test requests.
